name: cohort2_confirmation_Native_Last0_N144_O16_q6_s2026111822_P1Prep1Decode2_v3
scope: Coordinator delivery timestamps. First ITL is included. Finite-cohort drain rates are not sustainable capacity.

parent_tail_interval_identity.scope: Select parent intervals at or above its p99. Parent interval equals worker interval plus the change in receive lag. The worker interval still includes GPU and Host scheduling. This is not an additive decomposition of p99 or between-method regression.

prefill.scope: Native scheduler observations. WAITING_REMOTE_KVS is not compute-ready work. Detailed status counts remain in raw evidence.

decode.scope: Native scheduler observations. WAITING_REMOTE_KVS is not compute-ready work. Detailed status counts remain in raw evidence.

P_production_scope: Host observation start to final Source-ready notification. Includes compute, queue, preparation, and backpressure. This is not exclusive GPU compute or sustainable capacity.

arrival_observation_lag_ms.scope: Coordinator arrival observation is separate from a later Source submission. Older discovery logs do not contain this boundary.

coordinator_queue_observations.scope: All unified PD arms hold external requests in the coordinator. P_HOST_COMPUTE_PENDING is an external wait state. The common outstanding-window, KV and reservation gates can block admission. Queue growth alone is not evidence of P compute saturation.

output_gate.name: cohort2_confirmation_Native_Last0_N144_O16_q6_s2026111822_P1Prep1Decode2_v3
output_gate.scope: Preserved original BF16 reference outputs only. No historical latency reuse.

accounting_scope: STRUCTURAL_ACCOUNTING over actual completed requests, actual commits and prefix exports. Rows are not FLOPs or measured GPU time. Payload is valid logical state, not protocol headers or padding. Exported source block counts are actual metadata, not exclusive physical-HBM traffic or a retention-time integral. Equal valid KV bytes do not imply equal source KV-credit occupancy: layer cuts still allocate the full36-layer cache group.

transport_audit.name: cohort2_confirmation_Native_Last0_N144_O16_q6_s2026111822_P1Prep1Decode2_v3
transport_audit.scope: Native transfer telemetry and actual submitted ranges. Warm-up native counters are flushed at measurement begin. Manual descriptors are filtered by the measured host window. NIXL KV stats use seconds; hidden API fields use microseconds converted by the original wrapper. Concurrent transfer durations are not additive request critical paths or exclusive wire/kernel times. Hidden0 is supported only when the method sends no hidden state.

comparison_scope: Fixed partition, common admission predicate; natural GPU geometry can differ

common_reservation_gate.scope: The same existing prospective KV ledger is used by Native, Layer and Token. Every measured request has one grant, one committed allocation and one retirement. Worker validation checks its generation and cut. This verifies normal completion, not every failure/cancellation scenario.

actual_query_coverage_gate.scope: Actual unpadded query counts in measured GPU inputs. Prompt and generated Decode queries are separate. Prior state gates establish actual layer execution. This is not exclusive kernel timing.

per_request_P_query_coverage.scope: Original prompt positions at the actual source scheduler. Every prompt query must occur exactly once. Warm-up IDs are excluded.

observed_batch_structural_projection_cal.scope: Four Transformer projections per executed layer, counted from actual prepared batches. This is not a CUDA kernel-launch count. It excludes LM head, sampling, normalization and attention. Chunk fragmentation can change these calls despite matched aggregate token-layer rows.
